correctness.rationale: The orthant reduction, Tanaka identity, finite-variation zero-set restriction, contact-charge equivalence, absolute-continuity corollary, and boundary examples were checked against the source model and limiting cases.

originality.rationale: The recent moving-boundary perturbed-Brownian paper and classical orthant, perturbed-Skorokhod, and time-dependent-boundary references were checked. No inspected source states the exact defect identity, the subcritical iff contact-charge criterion, or the arbitrary locally absolutely continuous boundary corollary. Broader reflected-semimartingale literature remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result removes the prior square-root modulus condition for all locally absolutely continuous boundaries in the entire subcritical perturbation regime and identifies boundary Stieltjes charge on the contact set as the exact obstruction for the unique orthant candidate.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
